posts.zh:
dsh-api-key-pool 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。对话模型 API Key 轮换池：自动检测 settings 中的厂商，每个厂商下多 Key 轮询，401/403/429 自动切换，冷却恢复。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a428f3fb47d8b688db35.html
posts.en:
dsh-api-key-pool is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. API key rotation pool for your LLM providers: auto-discovers providers from settings, per-provider multi-key round-robin, failover on 401/403/429, and cooldown recovery.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a428f3fb47d8b688db35.html
